name: flow:auth
description: Initialize or refresh local authentication for flow.google.com; use on fresh clones or expired sessions.

name: flow:api
description: Inspect endpoints, inherited parameter groups, and reusable API execution for flow.google.com.

name: flow:browse
description: Operate flow.google.com directly in the logged-in browser when UI mode is requested or API is gated by CAPTCHA.

name: flow:list-projects
description: List and filter projects on flow.google.com via verified local API or browser UI before selecting a target project.

name: flow:api-list-projects
description: Execute "List Flow projects" via flow.google.com API using local auth/cookies; fallback to browser on CAPTCHA or expired session.

name: flow:browser-list-projects
description: Execute "List Flow projects" via flow.google.com browser UI; use when CAPTCHA is required, API is unverified, or UI is requested.

name: flow:create-project
description: Create a new project on flow.google.com via verified API (`jHPbke`) or browser UI, with support for follow-up renaming (`o8DA4`).

name: flow:api-create-project
description: Execute "Create a Flow project" via flow.google.com API using local auth/cookies; fallback to browser on CAPTCHA or expired session.

name: flow:browser-create-project
description: Execute "Create a Flow project" via flow.google.com browser UI; use when CAPTCHA is required, API is unverified, or UI is requested.

name: flow:rename-project
description: Reusable task to rename any Flow project by ID via verified API (`o8DA4`) or the project header editable input.

name: flow:api-rename-project
description: Execute "Rename an existing Flow project" via flow.google.com API using local auth/cookies; fallback to browser on CAPTCHA or expired session.

name: flow:browser-rename-project
description: Execute "Rename an existing Flow project" via flow.google.com browser UI; use when CAPTCHA is required, API is unverified, or UI is requested.

name: flow:open-project
description: Load a Flow project's metadata, scene/asset state, and model catalog via API (`ngNC2`, `Zzl0ze`, `HTrJv`) or open the project workspace in browser UI.

name: flow:api-open-project
description: Execute "Open and inspect a Flow project" via flow.google.com API using local auth/cookies; fallback to browser on CAPTCHA or expired session.

name: flow:browser-open-project
description: Execute "Open and inspect a Flow project" via flow.google.com browser UI; use when CAPTCHA is required, API is unverified, or UI is requested.

name: flow:configure-generation
description: Inspect or select generation mode (Image vs Video), model family, and model-dependent options (aspect ratio, output count x1-x4, resolution, duration) before submitting.

name: flow:api-configure-generation
description: Execute "Configure image/video model and dependent options" via flow.google.com API using local auth/cookies; fallback to browser on CAPTCHA or expired session.

name: flow:browser-configure-generation
description: Execute "Configure image/video model and dependent options" via flow.google.com browser UI; use when CAPTCHA is required, API is unverified, or UI is requested.

name: flow:generate-image
description: Submit an image prompt with model/aspect/count options in Flow; uses browser execution because standalone `ogiZ0b` RPC is gated by reCAPTCHA Enterprise (`PUBLIC_ERROR_UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY`).

name: flow:api-generate-image
description: Execute "Generate images in a Flow project" via flow.google.com API using local auth/cookies; fallback to browser on CAPTCHA or expired session.

name: flow:browser-generate-image
description: Execute "Generate images in a Flow project" via flow.google.com browser UI; use when CAPTCHA is required, API is unverified, or UI is requested.

name: flow:find-assets
description: Search and filter generated images, videos, scenes, and characters inside a Flow project workspace.

name: flow:api-find-assets
description: Execute "Search and filter project assets" via flow.google.com API using local auth/cookies; fallback to browser on CAPTCHA or expired session.

name: flow:browser-find-assets
description: Execute "Search and filter project assets" via flow.google.com browser UI; use when CAPTCHA is required, API is unverified, or UI is requested.

name: flow:project
description: Route flow.google.com tasks between reusable local API execution and browser UI workflows.
